name: SCROLL
fix_description: In transfer (func_17B1), the sender balance update uses unchecked subtraction: storage[sender] = storage[sender] - amount. This allows integer underflow when amount > balance, giving the sender a near-infinite balance. Fix: add a require(balance >= amount) check before the subtraction, or use SafeMath/checked arithmetic.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short, direct exploit that abuses an obvious token-level flaw via the Universal Router to move SCROLL tokens from arbitrary addresses, then performs a simple dump through a Uniswap V2 pair. It requires minimal protocol-specific reasoning, no flash loan or complex state setup, and the PoC is well under 100 lines with only a few external calls.
